content: Increment (i): reify the backend-neutral Obligation artifact (forge/src/obligation.rs) + the Engine trait & Verus engine (forge/src/engine.rs), route the per-item L3 CERTIFICATION discharge through the engine in check.rs. (5) the 0.1 vacuity/equivalence/strengthen meta-queries stay OUT. (6) tests in-module + forge/tests/engine_interface.rs cert-oracle identity (bin-only placement, mirroring degrade.rs verus_anchor).
